title: PGMS Backend
description: HTTP traffic, latency and errors by endpoint, business events, JVM and DB pool for the pgms Spring Boot backend.

panels.title: Backend
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status of /actuator/prometheus.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: API requests per second (actuator excluded).

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of API requests answered with 5xx. Alert threshold: 5% for 5m.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: 4xx ratio
panels.description: Client errors (validation, 401/403, 404, 409 conflicts, 429 rate limits). Some are expected business outcomes.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Avg latency
panels.description: Mean server-side latency of API requests.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: Heap in use as a share of -Xmx (max heap).

panels.title: DB pool busy
panels.description: Active Hikari connections / maximum pool size. Alert threshold: 80% for 5m.

panels.title: Request rate by endpoint
panels.description: Requests per second per route template (method + uri).

targets.expr: sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Responses by status
panels.description: 409 = business conflict (e.g. bed already reserved), 429 = rate limited.

panels.title: Errors by endpoint (4xx / 5xx)
panels.description: Only routes that returned 4xx/5xx in the interval.

targets.expr: sum by (method, uri, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of all API requests.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"4..", status!~"409|429"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

(sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"409|429"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average latency by endpoint
panels.description: sum/count of http_server_requests_seconds per route.

targets.expr: sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Max latency by endpoint
panels.description: Slowest single request per route in Micrometer's rolling window (~2 min). Spikes here precede p95 regressions.

targets.expr: max by (method, uri) (http_server_requests_seconds_max{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}) > 0

panels.title: p95 latency by endpoint (needs histogram buckets)
panels.description: Empty until the backend publishes buckets: management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram.http.server.requests=true. Until then use average and max latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (method, uri, le) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Endpoint summary (selected time range)
panels.description: Totals over the dashboard time range. Sort by any column.

targets.expr: round(sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])))

(sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))

sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range])) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri=~"$uri", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Bookings reserved
panels.description: increase(pgms_bookings_reserved_total) over the selected time range. Counters appear after their first event, so 0 = none yet.

panels.title: Bookings expired
panels.description: increase(pgms_bookings_expired_total) over the selected time range. Counters appear after their first event, so 0 = none yet.

panels.title: Check-ins
panels.description: increase(pgms_allocations_checked_in_total) over the selected time range. Counters appear after their first event, so 0 = none yet.

panels.title: Check-outs
panels.description: increase(pgms_allocations_checked_out_total) over the selected time range. Counters appear after their first event, so 0 = none yet.

panels.title: Transfers
panels.description: increase(pgms_allocations_transferred_total) over the selected time range. Counters appear after their first event, so 0 = none yet.

panels.title: Payments recorded
panels.description: increase(pgms_payments_recorded_total) over the selected time range. Counters appear after their first event, so 0 = none yet.

panels.title: Refunds issued
panels.description: increase(pgms_refunds_issued_total) over the selected time range. Counters appear after their first event, so 0 = none yet.

panels.title: Amount collected
panels.description: Sum of recorded payment amounts (pgms_payments_amount_sum) over the selected range.

panels.title: Booking & tenancy events
panels.description: Events per 5-minute bucket.

panels.title: Payments by method
panels.description: Payments recorded per method (and refunds) per 5-minute bucket.

panels.title: Amount collected
panels.description: pgms_payments_amount summary: total amount per 5-minute bucket and the average payment size.

panels.title: GC pause time (share of wall clock)
panels.description: Seconds paused per second. Sustained > 5% means the heap is too small or something is allocating heavily.

panels.title: GC pauses
panels.description: Pauses per second by collector and cause; points = longest recent pause (right axis).

panels.title: Thread states
panels.description: A growing 'blocked' band points at lock contention.

panels.title: Log events (warn / error)
panels.description: Count of WARN/ERROR log lines. Search the JSON logs by correlationId to drill in.

panels.title: Connection acquire / usage time (avg)
panels.description: Acquire = waiting for a connection; usage = how long a connection is held (long = slow transactions).

panels.title: Redis command latency (avg)
panels.description: Lettuce client latency per Redis command (rate limiting, token revocation, caches). Redis is optional: the app fails open.

panels.title: Repository calls (avg latency, top 10)
panels.description: Slowest Spring Data repository methods - where to look when DB pool usage climbs.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (repository, method) (rate(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_sum{application="$application", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (repository, method) (rate(spring_data_repository_invocations_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
